findings.label: Fail-open with no observability
findings.detail: guard_result.unavailable is appended as a step status but never counted, alerted, or circuit-broken. A guard outage is invisible to operators and silently allows all prompts through to the LLM.

findings.label: 4xx endpoint cached as working
findings.detail: _discovered_endpoint is set on any status_code < 500, including 401/404. A misconfigured token will permanently cache a rejecting endpoint, preventing discovery of a valid one.

findings.label: Flagged-range prompts mislabelled safe
findings.detail: When ML confidence is 0.5–0.7 (sent_to_review=True), step 6 writes label=0 (safe) to the Prompt table. Retraining pipelines consuming these rows will be trained on mislabelled data.

findings.label: context parameter is dead code
findings.detail: main.py calls llm_generate(text, resource) with no context argument. The f-string branch that appends context to the user message never executes in production.

findings.label: salary/payroll keyword asymmetry
findings.detail: Both keywords are hard-blocked at step 1 on the backend, but the frontend queryDatabase guard clause for Company excludes them from the directory path, implying they were expected to reach the DB layer. Confirm the hard-block is intentional.

findings.label: flagged/unavailable rendered as processing
findings.detail: SecurityCheckVisualization maps 'flagged' and 'unavailable' to the same grey/pulse style as 'processing', so users cannot distinguish a suspicious-but-allowed prompt from one still in flight.
